name: gobrador
description: Find public procurement opportunities (government tenders) in Spain by topic, CPV sector and region, read each tender's budget, deadline and documents, and, with a connected Gobrador account, work your tender radar and Evaluate board.

interface.longDescription:
Gobrador helps companies find and win public procurement opportunities (government tenders) in Spain. It searches the tenders published on Spain's Public Sector Procurement Platform (PLACSP). Ask for open tenders by topic, by CPV sector and by autonomous community, province or island, for example IT services in the Canary Islands or cleaning contracts in Seville, and get the contracting authority, budget, submission deadline in Spanish peninsular time and a link to each tender's page on gobrador.com. Open a tender to see its procedure, CPV codes, lots, whether it has been awarded, and direct download links for the administrative and technical specifications.

Searching and reading tenders works without an account. Connect your Gobrador account to use your radar of tenders that match your company, with a fit indicator; save tenders; work on your Evaluate board, shared with your team, where you move tenders between stages, assign an owner, comment and tick tasks; see key data about your market; and see who wins at a contracting authority, analyze companies and authorities and get a forecast for each open tender. Some features depend on your Gobrador account.

Intended for companies and freelancers in Spain looking for public contracts.

Limitations: covers Spain only. Sector and place filters apply to open tenders; closed tenders can be searched by text or by the contracting authority's tax ID. Account management, such as inviting or removing team members, and deleting comments or evaluations are done on gobrador.com, not from the chat.
capabilities: Your tender radar and saved tenders
Track tenders with your team on the Evaluate board
defaultPrompt: ¿Qué licitaciones de servicios informáticos hay abiertas en Canarias?
Busca concursos de limpieza abiertos en la provincia de Sevilla
¿Qué hay nuevo en mi radar esta semana?

positive.description: Search open tenders combining a CPV sector and a Spanish region (no account needed).
positive.prompt: What open public tenders for IT services are there in the Canary Islands?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls buscar_licitaciones once with cpv ['72'] and lugares ['Canarias'] (or 'Canary Islands') and estado 'abiertas'. Lists the tenders with contracting authority, budget, submission deadline in Spanish time and a link to each tender on gobrador.com.

positive.description: Read the connected account's radar: the open tenders that match the company profile.
positive.prompt: What's new in my Gobrador radar this week?
positive.expected_behavior: If the account is not connected yet, ChatGPT asks to connect Gobrador and the reviewer signs in with the test account. Then calls mi_radar and shows the open tenders that match the test company (cleaning and building maintenance in the Canary Islands), each with its verdict (fits, worth a look or not worth it) and the reason, contracting authority, budget and deadline, as cards with an 'Add to Evaluate' button.

positive.description: Add a tender from the radar to the Evaluate board (a write action on the connected account).
positive.prompt: Add the first one to my Evaluate board.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls anadir_a_evaluar with the id of the first radar tender. Confirms it was added to the team's Evaluate board in the 'En evaluación' stage and marked as interesting in the radar. Nothing is paid or sent to the contracting authority.

positive.description: Show the Evaluate board and open one evaluation with its tasks.
positive.prompt: Show me my Evaluate board and open the evaluation of the tender that closes first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls mi_evaluar and shows the tenders on the board grouped by stage, then calls ver_evaluacion for the one with the nearest deadline and shows its stage, owner, the team's comments and the five preparation tasks.

positive.description: Pro feature: who wins the contracts of a contracting authority.
positive.prompt: Who usually wins the contracts of the Ayuntamiento de Telde?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls competencia, or analizar_organismo (the fuller Pro profile of the same authority), for Ayuntamiento de Telde. Shows the companies with the highest awarded amount and how many contracts each won, the company that wins most often with its average discount, and the average number of bidders. The test account has the Pro plan, so the full answer is shown.

negative.description: Not a public procurement question: the plugin should not be used.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?

negative.description: Outside coverage: the plugin only covers Spain. If called, the tool returns a message that the place is not a Spanish region, province or island, and the assistant should explain that only Spain is covered instead of showing Spanish results as if they were French.
negative.prompt: Find open public tenders in Lyon, France.

negative.description: Unsupported account action: plan changes and payments are not available from the chat. The assistant should explain that the plan is changed on gobrador.com and must not claim to have changed it.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Gobrador subscription to the Business plan.

review.commerce_description: Gobrador's plugin does not sell products or process payments. Plans are bought and changed only on gobrador.com.

publication.release_notes: Connect your Gobrador account (OAuth): your tender radar, saved tenders, your Evaluate board with your team (stages, owner, comments and tasks), key market data, who wins at a contracting authority, company and authority analysis and tender forecasts. Interactive cards for results. Searching and reading tenders still works without an account.

es-ES.subtitle: Licitaciones públicas España
es-ES.description:
Gobrador busca licitaciones públicas de la Plataforma de Contratación del Sector Público. Pregunta por licitaciones abiertas por tema, por sector CPV y por comunidad autónoma, provincia o isla —por ejemplo, servicios informáticos en Canarias o limpieza en Sevilla— y obtén el organismo, el presupuesto, el plazo de ofertas en hora peninsular y el enlace a la ficha de cada una en gobrador.com. Abre una licitación para ver el procedimiento, los CPV, los lotes, si está adjudicada y los enlaces de descarga de los pliegos administrativo y técnico.

Para buscar y ver fichas no necesitas cuenta. Conecta tu cuenta de Gobrador para usar tu radar de licitaciones que encajan con tu empresa, con su semáforo; guardar licitaciones; tu tablero de Evaluar, compartido con tu equipo, donde mueves cada licitación de fase, asignas responsable, comentas y marcas tareas; los datos clave de tu mercado; y quién gana en un organismo, el análisis de empresas y organismos y la previsión de cada licitación abierta. Algunas funciones dependen de tu cuenta de Gobrador.

Para empresas y autónomos que buscan contratos públicos en España.

Límites: solo España. Los filtros de sector y lugar se aplican a licitaciones abiertas; las cerradas se buscan por texto o por el CIF del organismo. La gestión de la cuenta, como invitar o quitar a alguien del equipo, y borrar comentarios o evaluaciones se hacen en gobrador.com, no desde el chat.
